name: prepare_session_distill
description: Prepare one /hm:distill decision packet. An explicit session_id selects that session directly, including parked work. Semantic mode bundles the bounded decision windows so the common path can finalize without another prepare call.

client.description: Transcript source to sync before distill (default: auto)

limit.description: Maximum sessions to sync before distill (default: 5)

full_rescan.description: Ignore sync cursor and rescan matching sessions

scope.description: Session scope for global stores (default: project)

project_root.description: Project root for directory-first project resolution

observation_limit.description: Recent observations to include in the evidence packet (default: 5)

max_chars_per_observation.description: Deprecated compatibility field; packets are no longer truncated

run_ingest.description: Run low-level transcript sync before building the packet (default: true)

distill_job_id.description: Optional active job id to claim exactly. Used by bounded automatic maintenance so offered jobs are processed deterministically.

session_id.description: Optional user-facing session id to select directly. The latest matching project job is activated when parked.

defer_job_id.description: Failed job to release as retryable and skip for this call.

defer_reason.description: Bounded failure reason stored with defer_job_id.

chunk_limit.description: Lossless transcript chunks to claim in this Agent call (default: 1, max: 3)

evidence_mode.description: Evidence delivery mode. raw preserves the existing per-chunk Agent loop; semantic lets runtime hash-verify/checkpoint every raw chunk and returns the smaller parser-derived session rendering.

detail_level.description: Semantic evidence detail. compact returns a budgeted exchange outline; full returns the complete v1 semantic rendering.

budget_tokens.description: Advisory target for the complete serialized response. Compact evidence adapts to the remaining space; complete coverage or explicit drilldown may expand with a receipt.

drilldown_exchange_indexes.description: Read complete semantic windows for selected one-based exchange indexes before querying candidate-grade raw proof.

drilldown_chunk_indexes.description: Read-only raw chunk indexes to return after a job reaches reviewing; use for candidate-grade evidence drilldown.

drilldown_query.description: Read-only search over raw chunks after the job reaches reviewing. Returns up to 8 matching chunks when semantic evidence needs proof.
